# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- Project requirement: do not use JWT authentication.

## General Guidelines
- Prefer short, impersonal, expert responses in en-US for this project.
- Use concise, user-friendly error messages in the UI that do not include raw JS stack traces. Utilize HttpClient and parse ValidationProblemDetails or server responses to display clean messages.
- If the assistant's output is cut off or incomplete, continue and provide the full requested file or content. Finish README files completely when asked.
